# leostream_pool_assignment (Resource)

The poolassignment resource allows you to create, read, update, and delete poolassignments in Leostream.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "leostream_pool_assignment" "poolassignment_1" {

  policy_id    = 1
  pool_id      = 148
  offer_filter = 1
  offer_filter_json = {
    filters = [
      {
        offer_filter_attribute = "isMemberOf",
        offer_filter_condition = "eq",
        offer_filter_value     = "test"
      }
    ],
    join = "o"
  }
  plan_protocol_id = 2
  offer_quantity   = 1
  display_mode     = 0
  start_if_stopped = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (Number) Policy ID for which this assignment is valid
- `pool_id` (Number) Pool ID for which this assignment is valid

### Optional

- `display_mode` (String) How to describe the offered machines:
				0 = Desktop name (default)
				5 = Desktop display name
				1 = Machine name
				2 = Pool name
				3 = Pool name : Desktop name
				6 = Pool name : Desktop display name
				4 = Pool name : Machine name
				7 = Pool display name
				8 = Pool display name : Desktop name
				9 = Pool display name : Desktop display name
				10= Pool display name : Machine name
- `offer_filter` (String) The method used to decide whether desktops from this pool will be included in the offer.
				0: Included for all users (default)
				1: Only included if user's AD record matches the offer_filter_json criteria
				2: Only included if current date and time is within the offer_filter_json time ranges
- `offer_filter_json` (Attributes) offer_filter_json (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offer_filter_json))
- `offer_quantity` (Number) The number of VMs to offer to a user at login
- `plan_power_control_id` (Number) ID of power plan to assign
- `plan_protocol_id` (Number) ID of protocol plan to assign
- `plan_release_id` (Number) ID of release plan to assign
- `start_if_stopped` (Number) A boolean field indicating whether to attempt to power on a machine if it's currently stopped/suspended.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the poolassignment.

<a id="nestedatt--offer_filter_json"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offer_filter_json`

Optional:

- `filters` (Attributes List) Array container for Pool attributes (restrict_by is 'A') or for LDAP attributes (restrict_by is 'Z', requires Active Directory Centers). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offer_filter_json--filters))
- `join` (String) And/Or join condition - A or O

<a id="nestedatt--offer_filter_json--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offer_filter_json.filters`

Optional:

- `offer_filter_attribute` (String) Offer_filter_attribute
- `offer_filter_condition` (String) Offer_filter_condition
- `offer_filter_value` (String) Offer_filter_value

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

`$ terraform import leostream_pool_assignment <policy_id>:<poolassignment_id>`

 A Leostream pool assignment can be imported by specifying the numeric policy identifier, together with the poolassignment identifier.

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# An example of importing a Leostream pool assignment with the numeric identifier 123 and policy identifier 1

terraform import leostream_pool_assignment 1:123

```

>If the two numeric identifiers are not provided, or ony one, the import will fail with an error message:
>
> `Expected import identifier with format: <policy_id>:<pool_assignment_id>. Got:<input> `
